section: Iterate - feature: reject a proposed entry with an audit record
title: Reject proposals under the decisions lock, with an audit line
context: Campaign shadow-proposals-webui W3: a proposal could only be countersigned; nothing recorded who decided, and a rejected key could be proposed again unnoticed.
decision: POST /api/org/decisions/reject removes the entry under the FR-04.28 lock and appends one decision_rejected line (author, lead, key, optional reason; no quote) to the lead's audit.jsonl first; countersign appends decision_countersigned. Retries and double clicks record once.
consequences: Both kinds show in the audit view; a repeat of a rejected key is badged. Author is the server's OS account; audit.jsonl is lead-writable and not fsynced (accepted, see ADR file).
rationale: Smallest mechanism: reuses the existing lock, atomic write and audit file; audit-first ordering makes the retry idempotent; cross-action guards stop reject and countersign contradicting each other.
rejected: A WebUI-owned decisions-audit file (second store, dual audit view); client-only hiding (no record); editing the file by hand.
